messages:
jasper: 🚨 CI red on master after last night's secret rotation — unit-tests failing with KMS decrypt errors. snippet: `Error: failed to decrypt: AccessDeniedException` Anyone know if the CI service token got rotated?

mohit: seeing it too. failures during `sso-ci` step when fetching secrets from vault.

ci-bot: Failed job: unit-tests (build-4321) — https://ci.redwood.example/build/4321

elaine: @mohit can you check the Vault -> GH Actions role mapping? rotation might've created a new key without policy attachments.

mohit: looked at vault audit logs: new credential created at 2025-03-18T01:05Z but policy `ci-transit-decrypt` wasn't applied to role `ci-runner`. pipeline still referencing `ci-runner`.

jasper: can you reapply the policy? if it's a propagation delay we can try a rerun in the meantime, a few PRs are blocked.

mohit: re-applied policy. did a quick `vault token lookup` and tried a manual decrypt: `vault write transit/decrypt/ci ...` -> still `permission denied`. might need a full token re-issue.

kat: if rerun doesn't help I can run a quick bisect to see if any infra change caused this, want me to kick it off across the last 50 commits?

jasper: prefer retry first. @ci-bot can you trigger a forced rerun for build-4321? command in UI or `/ci rerun build-4321 --force`.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @jasper — queued rebuild build-4321-rerun-1.

sre-oncall: FYI if rerun fails, revert the rotation and escalate to security. I'll open an incident ticket and add on-call rotation.

kat: rerun completed — unit-tests now passing on build-4321-rerun-1. looks like permission propagation delay after policy attach. I'll still run a quick bisect tomorrow to be safe. :thumbsup:

jasper: thanks. filing follow-up task: add a post-rotation smoke check that runs `sso-ci` and a simple decrypt before closing rotation. assigning to @mohit.

mohit: ack — will add smoke check and update the rotation playbook + docs.
